raw_text: r/bangladesh — The anti-quota protests are escalating rapidly. Students from virtually every public university have walked out. The government's response has been heavy-handed — tear gas at Dhaka University, water cannons at Chittagong. Telegram channels are now the primary coordination tool because Facebook groups keep getting taken down. The Students Against Discrimination movement has grown from a campus grievance to a national crisis in under a week. International media is barely covering this. If you have contacts in journalism, please reach out.
